name: Inventory Master
notes: v1.0.4: Fixed main menu buttons becoming unresponsive after opening the F2 menu from the home screen's Mods Manager and closing it. Closing unconditionally switched to the "Player" input map and locked the cursor (meant for gameplay), which broke the home screen's own UI clicks since no player/world exists there. Now correctly switches to "UI" and frees the cursor when not in-game.
